@zk_circuit
@requires(lambda n: 0 <= n <= 1024)
def factorize_naive(n: Integer):
    """ A naive factorization method. Take integer 'n', return list of
        factors.
    """
    if n < 2:
        return []
    factors = []
    p = 2
    while True:
        if n == 1:
            return factors
        r = n % p
        if r == 0:
            factors.append(p)
            n = n / p
        elif p * p >= n:
            factors.append(n)
            return factors
        elif p > 2:
            p += 2
        else:
            p += 1
    assert False, 'unreachable'
